# Input

A one-line text field, 44 px tall, 16 px text and a 3:1 border.

```tsx
import { Input } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For short free text: names, emails, codes.

## When not to

- For long text: use Textarea.
- For choosing among known options: use Select, Radio or Checkbox.
- A placeholder as the label.

## Examples

### Text field

At least 44 px tall, 16 px text, and a 3:1 border so the field is visible without relying on a fill.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
  <Field label="Nombre completo"><Input autoComplete="name" /></Field>
  <Field label="Ciudad"><Input Icon={IconCheck} defaultValue="Bogotá" /></Field>
  <Field label="Código"><Input disabled defaultValue="No editable" /></Field>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `Icon` | `IconType` |  | Icon at the start of the field. Decorative: the label names the field. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  | Marks the field as invalid without a Field (inside a Field, its `error` does this). |
| …rest | `InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Size:** 44 px tall; 16 px text, so iOS does not zoom the page on focus.
- **Border:** 3:1 against the page in both modes (WCAG 1.4.11).
- **Invalid:** `aria-invalid` turns the border red; with a Field the error message appears too.
- **Autofill:** pass `autoComplete` and `type` (email, tel, search): they open the right keyboard and help password managers.

## Content

- Placeholders show an example, never an instruction.
